name: TerritoryConflict - Default (seed v1)
description: A contested zone where two territories of equal rank overlap. Written by the game server's territory report; read only here. Resolve it on its page (award the area to one holder, or mark the lines redrawn) (territory V1, #326).

steps.description: The world and the state of the conflict. Holders and the area are shown on the conflict's page.

fields.label: World
fields.description: The Minecraft world of the contested area.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Open until an admin resolves it.

fields.label: Still overlapping
fields.description: Off once the game server's last report no longer shows the overlap.

fields.label: Chunks
fields.description: How many chunks the contested area covers.

fields.label: Resolution
fields.description: Awarded = the area was given to one holder; Redrawn = the inputs were changed.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: The admin's note on the resolution.
